Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular pixel-art sprite atlas for an angled 2D zombie survival game. Reference image supplies art quality, lighting, anatomy and camera, NOT weapons or background. Male emergency responder, sandy brown short swept hair, navy rugged rescue jacket with prominent muted mustard shoulder yoke front and back, gray cuffs, black utility belt, radio and white medical pouch with small red cross. Exactly preserve approved responder identity.
Create ONLY UPPER BODIES from top of head to bottom of utility belt, including arms and hands; clean horizontal waist cut; no legs. These overlay animated legs and separately rendered weapon sprites. ABSOLUTELY NO GUN, KNIFE, BAT, BOTTLE OR OTHER HELD OBJECT in any cell: hands must be EMPTY in the specified gripping positions.
Exact grid TWELVE columns by FIVE rows, sixty equally spaced square cells, landscape 3072x1280 canvas. Transparent background and transparent gutters. No text, grid lines, shadows, floor, checkerboard or labels. Every torso fully inside its cell, body axis centered horizontally, belt baseline fixed at 80% cell height. Orthographic camera 45 degrees above ground, gritty polished high-detail pixel clusters, dark outlines, muted palette, matching reference.
Every row changes view: row1 right-facing east SIDE view; row2 down-right southeast FRONT three-quarter; row3 straight down south FRONT; row4 up-right northeast REAR three-quarter with back of head/jacket; row5 straight up north BACK. All twelve cells of each row keep that row's facing.
Twelve columns, in this exact order: 1 unarmed ready fists near chest; 2 unarmed punch extended; 3 one-handed melee ready, right fist forward near waist and left hand guarding chest; 4 melee wind-up, right fist above shoulder; 5 melee strike, right fist extending forward; 6 handgun two-handed grip with both EMPTY hands touching out in front; 7 same handgun grip raised slightly for recoil; 8 long-gun grip with right hand by shoulder and left supporting hand farther forward, clear EMPTY gap for rifle; 9 long-gun recoil, same empty hands; 10 reload, both hands close in front of chest manipulating nothing; 11 two-handed bottle grip at lower chest, one hand supporting base, other hand around invisible bottle; 12 bottle reload, left hand at lower chest and right pinching a mint above the invisible opening. Natural anatomically correct hands, consistent head size, waist registration, proportions and clothing across all poses. No weapons baked into the image. Each upper-body silhouette crisp, finished game art, not sketches.
